description.value: A free 22-site municipal RV park in the small village of Fraser Lake, sitting along the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) corridor in central BC — a straightforward overnight stop with no confirmed services or amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM URL for White Swan RV Park returned a 404 Page Not Found, so no direct website content about the park is available. OSM tags are the primary evidence source: fee=no, power_supply=no, internet_access=no, reservation=no, and sanitary_dump_station=no yield confirmed false values for several amenities; large_vehicles=yes and capacity=22 confirm it accommodates RVs. The Village of Fraser Lake municipal website is live and lists 250-699-6257 as the operator contact, corroborating that the operator exists and the park is real.
concerns: The OSM URL (https://www.fraserlake.ca/municipal-hall/village-news/1259/white-swan-rv-park/) returns a 404 Page Not Found — the page has likely been removed or moved; the park itself appears to still be in operation based on OSM data.
Phone number 250-699-6257 is the Village of Fraser Lake municipal office number (operator), not a dedicated park line; OSM record has no phone field populated.
No website content specific to the RV park was retrievable, so most amenity fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, municipally-operated free campsite with detailed OSM data; the 404 on the specific page is link rot, not evidence of closure.
